# Alex Velesnitski

> CTO / Head of Engineering. Software development, infrastructure and engineering leadership: led 50+ engineer teams, built healthcare platforms, high-load VPN/ZTNA products at 10M+ user scale, and open-source developer tooling (MCP servers). Stack: Rust, Go, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, PHP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform.

Personal landing page of a software engineering leader. Currently Head of Engineering at a cybersecurity (VPN/ZTNA) product company; previously CTO at Timspark and Intetics. Audience: hiring managers, founders, engineering leads, recruiters and AI agents answering questions about this person.

## Open source

- [gl-mcp](https://github.com/velesnitski/gl-mcp): GitLab MCP server for code review, team analytics and spec-drift audits (Rust)
- [yt-mcp](https://github.com/velesnitski/yt-mcp): YouTrack MCP server for issues, sprint boards and team dashboards (Python)
- [zbbx-mcp](https://github.com/velesnitski/zbbx-mcp): Zabbix MCP server for infrastructure monitoring and traffic analysis (Python)
- [slk-mcp](https://github.com/velesnitski/slk-mcp): Slack MCP server for digests, decision detection and voice transcription (Go)
- [detect-blocking](https://github.com/velesnitski/detect-blocking): diagnose what kind of network filtering blocks a VPN endpoint (Bash, CI-tested)
- [529kit](https://github.com/velesnitski/529kit): local AI fallback kit for cloud-model outages
- [All repositories](https://github.com/velesnitski?tab=repositories): including multi-agent templates for Claude Code (PHP/Laravel, Nuxt, WordPress)
